howto: Your crowd runs forward on its own. Steer left and right.
Run through the green half of each gate (x2, +10) to grow the crowd; the red half shrinks it.
Dodge the swinging maces and bars, and keep off the gate's centre post.
Reach the boss gate with 45 or more runners to burst it and win.
tips: A x2 gate early is worth more than a +10 gate late.
The centre post of every gate costs 3 runners: commit to one side.
A bar knocks out 6 and a mace 5, so dodging beats gambling on a bad gate.
A single bad gate can never wipe you out: it always leaves at least one runner.

controls.keyboard: Left / Right or A / D to steer; Space or Enter starts; M mutes; P or Esc pauses
controls.touch: Drag left and right to steer; tap to start; the pause button sits bottom right

difficulty: An adaptive curve: speed climbs from 12.5 to 24 on the way to the boss gate at 920 m, and gates and hazards come closer together (gates every 32 m at the start, every 19 m near the end).

cheats.effect: Your crowd jumps by 40 runners (and every run starts with 48)
Maces, bars and gate posts knock nobody out

features.one-tap-start: Tap anywhere on the title (or Space) to start
features.instant-restart: Run again on the results screen, Space, or Restart in the pause menu
features.best-score-badge: Best on the title card and a live Best cell in the HUD
features.tutorial-card: A skippable coach card before the first gate on the first run; Replay tutorial in How to play
features.results: Gate burst / Crowd wiped out screen with peak crowd, distance, gates, score and best

settings.quality: Graphics: High / Low button on the title card (Low renders at 1x pixel ratio for slower phones)
